title: Release Gate Readiness v1
description: Machine-readable release-candidate readiness gate. Defines phases, their status, and the evidence spine that the validator checks. The canonical source of truth for whether Rig Relay is eligible for RC promotion.

gate_id.description: Stable identifier for this readiness gate (e.g., 'rc_readiness_v0').

repository.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

head_sha.description: Git HEAD SHA at time of readiness gate generation.

branch.description: Git branch at time of readiness gate generation.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the readiness gate was generated.

overall_status.description: Derived overall gate verdict. Computed from phase statuses — never user-supplied.

allowed_markdown_exceptions.description: Markdown paths explicitly allowed as non-evidence references (e.g., AGENTS.md, README.md, LICENSE).

blocker_reference_enforcement.description: If true, referenced blocker_ids must exist in blocker JSONL.

validation_run_reference_enforcement.description: If true, referenced validation_run_ids must exist in validation run JSONL.

markdown_evidence_enforcement.description: If true, Markdown paths in required_evidence fail validation unless explicitly allowed.

passing_phase_blocker_check.description: If true, a phase with status 'passing' that references unresolved blockers triggers failure.

missing_evidence_enforcement.description: If true, missing required evidence paths fail validation.

test_classification_enforcement.description: If true, validation runs that report tests_run > 0 but omit test_classifications fail.

required_evidence.description: Paths to required evidence artifacts for this phase.

blocker_ids.description: Blocker IDs associated with this phase.

validation_run_ids.description: Validation run IDs associated with this phase.

schema_artifact_paths.description: Schema artifact paths governed by this phase.

test_artifact_paths.description: Test artifact paths governed by this phase.

telemetry_or_redaction_implications.description: Telemetry or redaction implications for this phase.

allowed_deferrals.description: Deferral reasons allowed for this phase.

remaining_seams.description: Remaining seams identified in this phase.

source_commit.description: Source commit SHA when phase was last updated.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when phase was last updated.
